title: Preface: the silent Savior stronger than accusations
english: Our Savior and Lord Jesus Christ, when [[false witnesses rose against him >> Bible:Matthew 26:59-63]], kept silent; when accused he answered nothing, trusting that the whole pattern of his life among the Jews was stronger than the false witnesses.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2 (1899) Perseus TEI; no Chadwick/ANF Crombie.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Celsus’s first charge: secret associations
english: Celsus’s first heading, meant to slander Christianity, is that believers make [[secret agreements with one another >> Bible:Acts 4:32]] and keep apart from common life. We answer from the open practice of the churches.
